model_assumptions.spatial: 1D ground line: y components of positions, spawn offsets, warp_offset, and the Time Dilation Field sphere project onto x; jump arcs, vertical aim, and terrain between actors are not modeled.
model_assumptions.accuracy: Rolled once at fire time; a missed shot spawns no damaging bolt. Hits still arrive with the bolt's travel delay (distance / projectile_speed).
model_assumptions.dodge_chance: Applies to every otherwise-landing enemy attack — contact or bolt arrival — rolled at the moment damage would land, after the i-frame gate.
model_assumptions.time_dilation: An active field slows the modeled player's movement and the player's bolts inside it by time_field_factor; fire cadence stays full speed (input registers — slowed, not stunned, gADR-0009).
model_assumptions.gravity_gun: Not modeled: the Gravity Gun, Gravity Fields, consumables, and pickups are outside the encounter model, so boss-wave TTD measures a laser-only brawl without the intended counterplay.
